name: labs/daanwielens__research-python
title: Lake Shore Model 332 temperature controller
intro: Lake Shore Model 332 temperature controller, adapted from daanwielens/research-python. It reads `temperature`, `temperature_celsius`, `heater_output` and `pid`; sets `setpoint`, `heater_range` and `manual_output`; runs `set_pid` and `heater_off`. `set_pid`: set the loop-1 proportional, integral and derivative terms. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
